messages:
zoe_sales: Heads-up: Nimbus Health wants a compact benchmark and a cost delta for reserved vs burst for their pilot. Baseline target = 220 rps steady, microbursts to 1.1k rps for 90s every 20m. They also asked about SAML + optional BYO-HSM for encryption keys and a 2-week privatelink. Can we confirm run plan, quick token estimate, and the minimal security checklist we can hand them right away?
arun_perf: Proposed stages: 1) warmup/cache-fill (18m @ 35%), 2) steady-state (90m @ 220rps), 3) burst block (10 cycles 90s@1100rps spaced 20m), 4) long soak (6h @120rps with jittered spikes). We should capture p50/p95/p99, batch size distribution, queue time, and kv-cache hit.
arun_perf: Runner example: ```rbench --model redwood-13b-q4 --target https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate --qps 220 --concurrency 88 --duration 5400 --burst-pattern "1100@90s:every20m" --warmup 1080``` Enable prefix caching and record batch hist.
claire_infra: Infra plan: provision 5 x a100-like nodes in sandbox, create two pools (steady + burst autoscaler). Canary route ready to fallback to redwood-7b-quant in ~2m. I'll schedule provisioning window for 2027-11-03 09:00 PT -> 2027-11-05 09:00 PT.
yasmin_sec: Minimal checklist (shareable): 1) IdP metadata XML for SAML 2.0, 2) list of test admin users, 3) corporate IPs for privatelink/VPC peering allowlist, 4) data residency/region, 5) BYO-HSM: yes/no. Note: BYO-HSM support requires extra onboarding (keys import & attestation). We can provide KMS-managed keys quickly. SOC2/ISO27001 reports available on request.
dan_ae: Cost ask: please give me an estimated token count & run cost for the full test window and a monthly reserved vs on-demand delta for baseline 220rps. Need a one-slide summary for procurement.
arun_perf: Quick token math (rough): assume 42 tokens/req avg. Tokens/hr = 220 * 42 * 3600 = 33,264,000 tokens/hr. For a conservative 18-hour mix (warmup+steady+bursts+soak) ~598.8M tokens. Using hosted unit $0.00065 per 1k tokens => run-token-cost ~= $389. Add a ~15% compute/burst overhead => ~$447. Reserved baseline unit price (committed) would be ~30% cheaper per token; bursts billed at on-demand with small premium. I'll prep a short table.
provision-bot: [system] Provision request accepted: 5 x a100-like instances allocated to sales-sandbox for 2027-11-03 09:00 PT -> 2027-11-05 09:00 PT. Artifacts path: /shared/sales/nimbus/2145678901/
arun_perf: Metrics to collect: p50/p90/p95/p99, tokens_per_request, batch_size_hist, queue_time_ms, gpu_util_pct, kv_cache_hit_pct, and per-request prompt length. Capture any 429/5xx IDs.
yasmin_sec: Quick pasteable snippet for customer email: "We support SAML 2.0 (IdP metadata + ACS), temporary privatelink/VPC peering (provide corporate IP ranges), KMS-managed keys by default. BYO-HSM supported with additional onboarding. SOC2 & ISO27001 attestations available. Please provide IdP metadata and a list of test admin accounts to start."
zeco_sales: @zoe_sales: small edit to include SLA ask.
zoe_sales: Good call 1. Propose 99% uptime for the scheduled POC window and an automated fallback to a smaller model if p95 breach persists >3m. I'll include that in the customer note.
arun_perf: Running a quick internal smoke in ~25m and will post p95/p99. If p99 looks high during bursts we should try increasing batching.max_wait_ms to 20-25ms and nudging batching.max_tokens up.
claire_infra: I'll upload runbook + cost sheet to /shared/sales/nimbus/2145678901/ once smoke completes.
dan_ae: Please also include a short procurement line: "baseline reserved discount (monthly) reduces per-token unit price by ~30%; burst usage billed at on-demand rates with 10% premium."
arun_perf: Smoke result (ops-bot): 10m steady 220rps -> p95=195ms, p99=410ms, kv_cache_hit=80%. Artifacts uploaded: /shared/sales/nimbus/2145678901/smoke-2145678901.csv
yasmin_sec: Reaction: security side all set for quick turnaround once IdP metadata + IP ranges provided. BYO-HSM will add ~1 week onboarding.
zoe_sales: Thanks team 44d I'll send the customer email with run plan, cost slide, security snippet and the 99% POC SLA. Will update thread after call.
